DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Arteritis (Temporal Arteritis).

Given your age, the 3-week history of headache with progressive vision loss, and the absence of fever or weight loss, I am concerned for an ocular ischemic event. While we have not yet received the results for the visual field or intraocular pressure, the clinical picture strongly suggests inflammation of the temporal arteries threatening your sight. Please return immediately to the emergency department for an urgent ESR/CRP check, a temporal artery biopsy, and initiation of high-dose corticosteroids to prevent permanent blindness.
